description: Haltestellen des öffentlichen Verkehrs is a series of datasets listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Amt für Geoinformation Kanton Schwyz. Abbildung aller Haltestellen des öffentlichen Verkehrs im Kanton Schwyz (Bus, Eisenbahn, Luftseilbahn und Schiff). Coverage: Amt für Geoinformation Kanton Schwyz. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Amt für Geoinformation Kanton Schwyz. It offers 2 resource(s) in WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
